name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I've spent the last few years on both sides of the problem you're solving. At Birdeye I managed a reseller partner book on a reputation and review platform, and at Solenzo I build review-generation workflows for contractors and other home-services businesses, the exact kind of providers whose reviews your platform partners host. Helping marketplaces own that signal instead of renting it from Google or Yelp is a product I understand and believe in.

The partner side of this role is work I've done well. At Birdeye I owned the technical relationship with 15 to 20 reseller partners, ran demos, guided them through complex setup, and retained all but one, roughly 94%, largely by spotting adoption gaps early and getting clear, prioritized issues in front of Product and Engineering. At Accelo I advised C-suite buyers while guiding onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations through setup, so I've worked the gap your posting describes between the buyer who signed and the team that deploys.

On the technical side, I connect platforms through REST APIs, Zapier, Make, and n8n, and write JavaScript and Python in code steps when a connector can't handle the data. As a solo founder there's no support team behind me, so I dig in, fix it, and document it. I'd welcome the chance to talk about your partner portfolio and how I'd approach the first few implementations.
